task: Continue production on SEQ-004 of a long feature. Load the sequence shard first and do not load the complete feature state unless a global gate requires it.
notes: Feature work should normally enter through the current sequence shard.

task: A context shard conflicts with the current canon file. Decide which source controls the correction.
notes: A shard is a bounded working set, not a replacement for authoritative canon.

task: The production health report says healthy. Explain whether that proves the movie is good.
notes: Health reports deterministic state, not artistic quality.

task: A character injury from SEQ-002 must still be visible in SEQ-009. Record a long-range continuity check instead of relying on memory.
notes: Non-adjacent continuity needs durable anchors and observations.

task: Prepare a mixed image/video/audio batch on a memory-limited local machine. Build the generation budget before arming the batch.
notes: Do not guess that all models fit.

task: The machine rebooted during a long feature. Resume safely without reconstructing progress from conversation history.
notes: Reboot recovery uses the checkpoint and current control hashes.

task: JOB-014 failed after JOB-001 through JOB-013 completed. Build a retry batch without regenerating independent completed jobs.
notes: Retry only failed/pending jobs and affected dependents.

task: A selected shot is absent from the main feature timeline. Reconcile editorial state and block the final master until the omission is resolved.
notes: Selection and timeline placement are separate states.

task: film_master.mp4 exists, but coverage and sequence approval are incomplete. Decide whether the project is complete.
notes: A master file alone cannot satisfy feature completion.

task: Create a final festival packet as PDF. Ensure a meaningful human-readable equivalent is shipped beside it.
notes: Rich documents require same-basename Markdown companions.

task: Install only the story-film-suite skill with an Agent Skills installer. The installed skill must still have its router, scripts, references, and docs.
notes: The npx skill bundle must not depend on repository-root files that are outside the selected skill folder.

task: The v0.0.11 deterministic suite passes. Begin the post-prototype local-model testing phase without replacing deterministic validation with model judgment.
notes: Local smoke testing complements deterministic gates after v0.0.11.
